meta.title: Liquid Cooling (Spatial) · AI Data Center
meta.description: Interactive 3D section of a liquid-cooled micro module with dual rows and an enclosed cold aisle.

info.title: Liquid-Cooled Micro Module
info.copy: Select the micro module, piping or trays to inspect function and elevation.

hint.drag: Drag to orbit · right-drag to pan · scroll to zoom · select a component for details

fallback.title: 3D rendering is unavailable
fallback.body: Enable hardware acceleration or use a current Chrome, Edge, or Safari browser.

rack.title: Liquid-Cooled Micro Module
rack.copy: Fourteen liquid-cooled racks face an enclosed cold aisle with transparent roof panels, sliding end doors, in-row cooling and a monitoring screen. Every rack connects to underfloor supply/return piping and overhead A/B power.

servers.title: Liquid-Cooled Compute Nodes
servers.copy: High-density AI servers connect to rack manifolds with quick-connect hoses and receive dual power from overhead PDUs.

manifold.title: Rack Supply / Return Manifolds
manifold.copy: Green carries cold fluid; red carries heated return fluid. Quick-connect branches serve every cold plate.

supply.title: Green Cold-Fluid Main
supply.copy: The green cold-fluid main enters beneath the raised floor, rises through the rack base and feeds the supply manifold.

return.title: Red Hot-Fluid Main
return.copy: Red heated fluid drops through the rack base and returns below the floor to the CDU or heat exchanger.

busway.title: Overhead Row Busway
busway.copy: Independent A/B busways move down into the rack-top tray zone and use shorter vertical drops to feed the rack PDUs.

powerBridge.title: Power Cable Trays
powerBridge.copy: Two power trays sit close to the rack top and above the fiber tray, with most service clearance retained above the tray stack.

fiber.title: Fiber Tray
fiber.copy: The fiber tray sits below the power trays to reduce power/data interference.

fire.title: Fire Protection Main
fire.copy: The fire main is located within the fire protection and return-air zone below the beams, above the power and fiber trays.

ceiling.title: Fire Protection & Return Air
ceiling.copy: Fire protection piping and ceiling return air share a 1400mm zone below the beams.

floor.title: Raised Floor System
floor.copy: The 1000mm raised-floor void provides a dedicated pathway for liquid-cooling supply and return mains.
